description: Historical price snapshots for ONE item (item_code, from get_market): last N points (limit 1-200, default 50) with timestamps and a trend percentage. Read-only; use it to judge whether the current station price is high or low before buy/sell or place_orders. Needs no docking.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

name: get_price_history
